name: assetpanda/login-splash
title: AP Login Splash
description: Login-screen splash: a full-viewport panel with a background picture and a centred column of headings, copy, images and a button, sized for the iframe the product's login page draws (it hides the top 125px and is 100vh + 125px tall). Live: the 20 /login-splash-*/ pages (rules ported from the live theme's .login-splash sheet). Renders without the site header and footer on the login-splash template. This block is an adapter — it holds no markup; it maps attributes to kit props.
